newsitem.title: USA: Summit Design to sell certain assets.
newsitem.headline: Summit Design to sell certain assets.

text.p: Summit Design Inc said it has a definitive agreement to sell the assets of its Test Systems Strategies subsidiary used in its Test Development Series products to Credence Systems Corp for $5 million.
Credence plans to continue marketing the TDS products and will provide support to current TDS customers, the companies said.
The acquisition of the TDS assets is subject to standard closing conditions and is scheduled to close in early July 1997, they said.
Summit is a supplier of engineering software products for the creation of electronic systems and integrated circuits. Credence manufactures automatic test equipment for the semiconductor industry.
